screenReplacement.name: Screen replacement
screenReplacement.shortDescription: Fast, high-quality screen replacement for all models
screenReplacement.fullDescription: Our specialists replace screens on smartphones of every brand. We use only original or high-quality compatible parts, which guarantees excellent image quality and a long service life.

batteryReplacement.name: Battery replacement
batteryReplacement.fullDescription: Over time a smartphone battery loses capacity and runs down faster. We replace batteries professionally using quality components, which restores how long your device lasts on a charge.

boardRepair.name: Motherboard repair
boardRepair.fullDescription: Motherboard repair is one of the most demanding procedures and calls for a high level of skill. Our technicians have years of experience diagnosing and repairing boards, solving connectivity, power and other component faults.

screenProtection.name: Screen protection
screenProtection.fullDescription: Protect your device from scratches and damage with professionally fitted tempered glass or film. We guarantee a perfect application with no air bubbles or dust.

phoneCleaning.name: Phone cleaning
phoneCleaning.shortDescription: Professional cleaning from dust and dirt
phoneCleaning.fullDescription: Over time dust, dirt and other contaminants build up inside your device and can affect how it performs. We professionally clean both the exterior and the internal components of your smartphone.

waterDamageRepair.name: Water damage repair
waterDamageRepair.shortDescription: Rescuing devices after contact with liquid
waterDamageRepair.fullDescription: If your device has been exposed to water or another liquid, acting fast matters. Our specialists professionally clean and restore the components affected by moisture, which maximises the chance of a full recovery.

faq.metadataDescription: Frequently asked questions about DeviceHelp mobile phone repair for companies, entrepreneurs, and organizations.
faq.title: Company service FAQ
faq.subtitle: Short answers about registration, account approval, and repairs for company devices.

items.question: Can an entrepreneur or small business register?
items.answer: Yes. A business account is suitable for companies, entrepreneurs, and small teams that need to repair work devices.

items.question: Can a company register with only one phone?
items.answer: Yes. Registration can still make sense for one device if you want company details and communication separated from regular consumer orders.

items.question: What happens after registration?
items.answer: After email confirmation, we check the company details. Once approved, we notify you by email.

items.question: Are repairs covered by warranty?
items.answer: Yes. Completed repairs include warranty depending on the service type and parts used.

items.question: Can we talk before registering?
items.answer: Yes. You can call us or email us first, and we will help choose the most convenient cooperation process.
